request.style: English, male solo voice, solemn and narrative, acoustic guitar, strings, piano, organ, harp, hymn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Joktan fathered Almodad
Sheleph came next in the line
Hazarmaveth and Jerah
In the east they drew near

[Verse]
Sons of Shem after the Flood
Descendants of Noah's blood
A family tree from the start
In the land of the east part

[Verse]
Thirteen sons in the list
Of Joktan's lineage distinct
In the mountain regions high
Under the open sky

[Verse]
Genesis records their names
Chronicles repeats the same
From the beginning of days
To the light of our eyes

[Verse]
Part of the nations spread
After the Tower's head
Scattered across the land
By the Father's command

[Outro]
Sheleph remains in the text
